component.name: Zephyr
component.summary: A modern, lightweight Mihomo GUI client

description.p: Zephyr is a state-of-the-art cross-platform GUI client for Mihomo, combining modern desktop aesthetics, high performance with Rust and Tauri v2, and a 13-layer security defense architecture.

ul.li: High performance and low memory footprint with Tauri v2 and native Rust IPC
Zero heavyweight frontend frameworks — pure native JavaScript UI
Full proxy protocol management, subscription parsing, and latency testing
Real-time traffic oscilloscope monitoring and system tray integration

description.p: Zephyr v2.4.3 release with UI optimizations, multi-architecture Linux package improvements, and security enhancements.
